og.alt: Auth (@pyreon/auth): Sign-in where the unsafe options don't exist.

hero.alt: auth.signIn() runs five steps: authorization request with S256 PKCE, state and nonce; the provider sign-in; the callback, where the code is scrubbed from the address bar and state is checked; the code exchange; and ID-token verification of signature, nonce and issuer. auth.status() moves from signedOut to signingIn to signedIn only after the last check. A side panel lists what is not offered at all: the implicit flow, the password grant and PKCE plain.
